text.p: Unitrin Inc and Reliable Life Insurance Co said Wednesday they agreed in principle for Unitrin to acquire Reliable, a St. Louis-based insurance firm.

Each holder of Reliable Class A common stock will be entitled to receive 2.235 shares of Unitrin common stock or $119 in cash, provided that no more than 20 percent of the acquisition consideration will be paid in cash, they said.

It is expected that Reliable will have 1,682,403 Class A shares outstanding, which will be acquired in the acquisition, and that all outstanding Class B common shares will be converted into Class A shares prior to closing.
It is intended that the transaction will be structured as a tax-free reorganization.
The transaction requires a definitive acquisition agreement, approvals by the directors of both companies, certain insurance and other regulatory authorities and Reliable's shareholders.

Unitrin and Reliable said they intend to enter into an acquisition agreement as soon as possible. A meeting of Reliable's shareholders to vote on the transaction will be held as soon as practicable thereafter. It is anticipated that the acquisition will be completed by September 30, 1997.
From its St. Louis headquarters, Reliable operates throughout Missouri, Arkansas and Texas in the business of life and health insurance.

Unitrin is engaged in life and health insurance through United Insurance Company of America and its subsidiaries; property and casualty insurance through Trinity Universal Insurance Company and its subsidiaries; and the consumer finance business through Fireside Thrift Co.
